record.t: Was chosen by House Democrats to be their leader for the next two years.
record.q: Democrats who won North Carolina House seats last month chose Rep. Robert Reives on Thursday to be their leader for the next two years.

record.t: Was named co-chairman of the House Freshman Caucus and treasurer of the Legislative Black Caucus after winning his first full term.
record.q: After winning his first full term in 2014, Robert was named co-chairman of the House Freshman Caucus and treasurer of the Legislative Black Caucus.

record.t: Was elected Deputy Democratic Leader by his colleagues.
record.q: Just two years later, he was elected Deputy Democratic Leader by his colleagues, making him the second highest ranking Democrat in the North Carolina House of Representatives.
